characters.continuity: StarCraft II (Wings of Liberty through Legacy of the Void)
characters.summary: Jim Raynor is the leader of Raynor's Raiders, an honest, improvising guerrilla commander and a highly proficient revolver shot who fights in marine combat gear and rides a modified vulture hovercycle.

techniques: Improvises with whatever is on hand
Commands Raynor's Raiders (hijacked Mengsk's flagship Hyperion)

mechanisms: Marine combat armour / combat gear worn over his clothes

weaknesses: Not established by the cited sources
mobility: Rides a modified vulture hovercycle for transport and open-land combat
limitations: No superhuman powers; relies on weapons, armor and his Raiders

sources.supports: StarCraft Wiki: revolver proficiency, improviser, "able pilot" (tactical abilities), shot Tychus Findlay with the bullet meant for Mengsk, beat a fully armored Findlay in a bar fight.

Wikipedia (Wikiwand): marine combat armour, modified vulture hovercycle, hijacking the Hyperion, Wings of Liberty artifact restores Kerrigan, Raynor kills Findlay to stop him killing Kerrigan, Legacy of the Void Void assault on Amon.

feats.claim: Recovered the Xel'Naga artifact pieces whose detonation destroyed nearby Zerg and returned Kerrigan to human form.

notableResults.citation: StarCraft Wiki: Jim Raynor; Wikipedia: Jim Raynor
notableResults.note: Wings of Liberty finale: shot Findlay with his revolver to stop him killing the weakened Kerrigan on Mengsk's orders.
Earlier bar fight: beat a fully armored Findlay.

unknowns: Removed (not supported by opened sources): C-14 gauss rifle, demolition charges, orbital strikes, stimpacks, ammunition limit; Arcturus Mengsk result (Kerrigan killed Mengsk, not Raynor).

Tag proposals not applied: pilot (the wiki calls him "an able pilot" but no piloting feat was found; a vulture is a ground hovercycle), powered-armor (standard marine armour does not qualify under the owner ruling).

characters.continuity: Arcane (Netflix series), with her League of Legends arsenal
characters.summary: Jinx, born Powder in Zaun, is an unstable gunner and bomber who fights with the minigun Pow-Pow, the shark-styled rocket launcher Fishbones, the shock pistol Zapper and Flame Chomper grenades.

techniques: Explosives (bridge bombings; rocket attack on the Piltover Council)

mechanisms: Not established by the cited source

weaknesses: Not established by the cited source
limitations: Emotionally unstable: killed Silco in a psychotic fit and fell into depression after Isha's death

sources.supports: Wikipedia (Wikiwand): weapon names (Pow-Pow, Zapper, Flame Chompers, Fishbones); Zaun origin and explosives; Arcane plot: kills six enforcers stealing Jayce's gem, kills Silco, rockets the Council, final battle against Viktor and Noxus.

feats.claim: Stole a Hextech gemstone from Jayce, killing six enforcers in the process.
Fired a rocket-powered weapon at the Piltover Council as it approved Zaun's independence.

notableResults.note: Kidnapped setting: gunned him down when he almost shot Vi; not a fair fight.
Arcane finale: seemingly sacrifices herself to save Vi and kill Vander; she may have survived.

campaignTags.claim: Fights with the shock pistol Zapper.

unknowns: Removed (not supported by opened source): Super Mega Death Rocket, city-block destruction feat, acrobatic evasion, Vi result (no decisive fight outcome given).
Tag proposals not applied: gadgets (customized firearms and grenades are weapons, not gadget tech), fire (Flame Chompers are described only as explosive grenades).

characters.summary: Joel Miller is a hardened survivor who fights hostile humans and infected with firearms, improvised weapons, hand-to-hand combat and stealth, and crafts health kits, shivs and Molotov cocktails.
weaknesses: Not established by the cited source

sources.supports: Wikipedia: The Last of Us gameplay (firearms, improvised weapons, hand-to-hand, stealth, crafting health kits, shivs and Molotovs, Listen Mode) and plot (Joel battles to the operating room, kills the lead surgeon, shoots Marlene; Ellie kills David).

feats.claim: Battled his way through the Firefly hospital to the operating room to save Ellie and killed the lead surgeon.

notableResults.note: Shot her dead in the hospital parking garage to stop the Fireflies pursuing them.

unknowns: Corrected: the David result was wrong; Ellie, not Joel, kills David (she hacks him to death with a machete).
Stealth is documented only as a general gameplay option, not a specific feat, so the stealth tag is not applied (owner ruling).
Removed: dodge rolls (not on the opened page).

characters.summary: In Kirby and the Forgotten Land, King Dedede joins the Beast Pack and fights Kirby with his hammer, the Head Slide and shockwave-making Super Dedede Jumps, switching to a huge pillar when weakened.

techniques: Pillar swings that crack icy fissures and scatter stars

mechanisms: Not established by the cited source

weaknesses: Not established by the cited source
mobility: Super Dedede Jump and spinning jump

sources.supports: WiKirby boss stage "An Unexpected Beast King": Dedede's Forgotten Land attacks (hammer, Head Slide, Super Dedede Jump with shockwaves, pillar at 40% health), why he fights, and Kirby defeating him.

feats.claim: After losing to Kirby, got up, caged Elfilin and escaped with him.

notableResults.note: Boss fight in the Beast Pack arena; Kirby wins, but Dedede then captures Elfilin and escapes.

unknowns: Removed (not supported by opened source): inhaling and spitting, inflation floating, armor plating, stone-pillar smashing feat, and the giant-sized tag (no documented size of about 8 ft or more).
Whether Dedede was controlled by the Beast Pack is not stated on the opened page.

characters.summary: Kirby is a pink, roughly eight-inch hero who inhales enemies and objects, spits them as Star Bullets or swallows them for Copy Abilities, hovers by holding his breath, swims without needing air and, in Forgotten Land, takes on the shape of huge objects with Mouthful Mode.

techniques: Star Bullet (spits inhaled objects at high speed)
Copy Abilities gained by swallowing foes

mechanisms: Not established by the cited source

weaknesses: Hovering is slow and leaves him vulnerable
mobility: Hover: flies by holding air and flapping his arms
limitations: Stands at most about eight inches (20 cm) tall

sources.supports: WiKirby: Inhale, Star Bullet, Copy Abilities, Drop Ability, Hover flight, Air Bullet, swimming without needing air, Water Gun, Warp Star, Mouthful Mode, height.
WiKirby: in Kirby and the Forgotten Land, Kirby defeats King Dedede in "An Unexpected Beast King".

notableResults.note: Forgotten Land boss fight; Dedede then escapes with Elfilin.

campaignTags.claim: Hovers by taking in air and flapping his arms.
Does not need to come up for air underwater.

unknowns: Removed (not supported by opened sources): inflatable body shielding, "infinite" flight, losing copied abilities on heavy damage, swallowing giant bosses whole.

characters.summary: Hypernova Kirby, gained by eating a Miracle Fruit in Kirby: Triple Deluxe, turns Kirby's stomach into "a veritable black hole" so he can inhale giant objects and foes and spit them back.

techniques: Hypernova Inhale: pulls in objects and foes far larger than a normal inhale
Spits inhaled stones, missiles or attacks back at enemies

mechanisms: Inhales and spits back incoming projectiles and lasers (Flowered Sectonia fight)

weaknesses: Not established by the cited source
limitations: Lasts until the stage ends; Miracle Fruit appears only in certain stages
characters.formDifferences: Gained from a Miracle Fruit: a far stronger inhale that takes in giant objects, mid-bosses and bosses immediately, and spits them or their attacks back. Lasts until the stage ends.

sources.supports: WiKirby: Hypernova from Miracle Fruit, black-hole inhale of giant objects, spitting stones/missiles, duration until stage end, instantly inhaling mid-bosses and bosses like Flowery Woods, defeating Flowered Sectonia by spitting her laser back.

feats.claim: Inhaled Flowered Sectonia's giant laser and spat it back to finish her off.

notableResults.note: Final battle; King Dedede and Taranza supplied the Miracle Fruit.

conditional.ability: Black-hole inhale of giant objects, mid-bosses and bosses
conditional.dependsOn: Eating a Miracle Fruit; lasts until the stage ends

unknowns: Replaced the Miracle Fruit cite (which never named the form) with the Hypernova page. Removed "planetary-scale suction" conditional: no scale is documented.

characters.summary: Star Rod Kirby wields the Star Rod, the magical scepter at the heart of the Fountain of Dreams, as his Last Battle Ability against Nightmare in Kirby's Adventure, swinging it to fire unlimited Star Bullets.

techniques: Swings the rod to fire Star Bullets
Spinning jump with the rod out

mechanisms: Not established by the cited source

weaknesses: Not established by the cited source
mobility: Flies on the Warp Star (returns the rod to the fountain after the battle)
limitations: Used only as the final-battle ability against Nightmare; Kirby keeps it when hit
characters.formDifferences: Kirby holds the Star Rod instead of a Copy Ability and fires unlimited Star Bullets from it; he keeps it even when hit.

sources.supports: WiKirby: Star Rod as the magical scepter of the Fountain of Dreams; Last Battle Ability vs Nightmare (Power Orb and Wizard forms); Star Bullet attacks, rapid fire, spinning jump; Nightmare vanquished.

notableResults.note: Kirby's Adventure: defeats Nightmare's Power Orb and Nightmare Wizard forms with the Star Rod.

campaignTags.claim: Wields the Star Rod, a magical scepter.

unknowns: Corrected: Gemini's feat "destroyed the Fountain of Dreams' source of corruption" is not on the page; the documented outcome is defeating Nightmare.
Removed: "magical energy deflection" and "vulnerable if disarmed" (not documented).
